title: Convert a text file to another format (RTF, HTML, TXT)
summary: Use the built-in `textutil` command to convert text files between formats like RTF, HTML, and plain text. This is useful for cleaning up documents or preparing them for web use.

steps.explain: Convert the specified file to the desired format. The output file will have the same name but a new extension (e.g., .txt, .html, .rtf).

placeholders.name: FORMAT
placeholders.description: The target format: txt, html, rtf, doc, docx, or wordml

alternatives.explain: Convert rich text (RTF) to plain text (TXT).

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the source RTF file

alternatives.explain: Convert a plain text file to RTF with specific font settings.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the source TXT file
